specificSetting: public debate about whether institutional guidance weakens intellectual independence
centralTension: structured guidance as equality of access versus autonomy as the condition of mature learning

tasks.scenario: Two source texts disputing the relationship between guidance and learner autonomy
tasks.purpose: synthesise competing claims, evaluate assumptions and develop an independent position
tasks.originalityCheck: Unique source texts with distinct arguments; no overlap with previous tests.

tasks.scenario: Review of a book examining dependence on educational expertise
tasks.purpose: evaluate argument, method and contemporary relevance
tasks.originalityCheck: Book title and focus on expertise dependence are new; no reuse of previous review topics.

tasks.scenario: Report on decision-making autonomy within a learning organisation
tasks.purpose: analyse structural barriers and recommend proportionate reform
tasks.originalityCheck: Specific foundation and focus on structural barriers; distinct from previous report tasks.

tasks.scenario: Article exploring whether productive uncertainty should be designed into education
tasks.purpose: interrogate the concept and reach a nuanced conclusion
tasks.originalityCheck: Novel concept of designing uncertainty; no similar article task in previous tests.

notes: All tasks adhere to the design fingerprint. No generic phrases or forbidden concepts used. Each task has a concrete audience and clear communicative purpose.
